8.2.2 MemIf_JobResultType
[SWS_MemIf_00065] Definition of datatype MemIf_JobResultType
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00392
⌈
Name
MemIf_JobResultType
Kind
Enumeration
MEMIF_JOB_OK
–
The job has been finished successfully.
MEMIF_JOB_FAILED
–
The job has not been finished successfully.
MEMIF_JOB_PENDING
–
The job has not yet been finished.
MEMIF_JOB_CANCELED
–
The job has been canceled.
MEMIF_BLOCK_
INCONSISTENT
–
1. The requested block is inconsistent, it may
contain corrupted data. 2. Block is NOT
found.
Range
MEMIF_BLOCK_INVALID
–
The requested block has been marked as
invalid, the requested operation can not be
performed.
Description
Denotes the result of the last job.
Available via
MemIf.h
⌋
